notes.subject: kirapim nem
notes.rationale: נשא את שם i tok blo Picasso: 'kirapim nem', i mining 'usim nem long pasin nogut o long tok giaman' — literal 'karim' i no klia.

notes.subject: no pulap
notes.rationale: לא ינקה i mining 'bai i no klia long kot, bai i no go longwe' — literal i 'bai i no klin', mi tanim olsem 'bai i no pulapim em'.

notes.subject: Yisrael
notes.rationale: Lo i tok stret long yu — Yisrael.

notes.subject: תשא / ישא / לשוא
notes.rationale: Tok 'nasa' (kirapim) na 'shav' (nating) i kamap tupela taim — repitisen i strongim lo.

translation: Yu no ken kirapim ⟨את⟩ nem bilong Yahwe Elohim bilong yu long samting nating; bilong Yahwe bai i no pulap long ⟨את⟩ man i kirapim ⟨את⟩ nem bilong en long samting nating.
